issue_context.title: Allow window to be transparent
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

For an example this feature would help users build desktop widgets or something similar to this game: https://samperson.itch.io/desktop-goose

## What solution would you like?

A way to set the transparency of the window on application init or in a system

## What alternative(s) have you considered?

I've tried accessing the `ResMut<Windows>` but no api is exposed to modify the winit window transparency 

## Additional context

It seems that winit allows the transparency to be set via the WindowBuilder but not after the creation of the window.
winit docs:
https://docs.rs/winit/0.25.0/winit/window/struct.WindowBuilder.html#method.with_transparent
https://docs.rs/winit/0.25.0/winit/window/struct.WindowAttributes.html#structfield.transparent
comments: AFAIK, this is blocked on `wgpu` supporting the feature: https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu/issues/687

> AFAIK, this is blocked on `wgpu` supporting the feature: [gfx-rs/wgpu#687](https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu/issues/687)

I've found a solution through the winit window builder, see: #3033 for more info

I think I found a workaround on Linux, forcing `winit` to run on it's master branch fixes this, or at least just on my Manjaro Linux machine with Nvidia proprietary drivers. I'm assuming that this now works because of this PR: [rust-windowing/winit#2006](https://github.com/rust-windowing/winit/pull/2006)

TLDR: What I said is irrelevant in current Bevy versions.

This was a while ago, not sure exactly what I meant. IIRC, I might've ran some code that "implemented" PR #3033/#3105, but without directly modifying Bevy's source. Then, I ran into another issue. There was a bug in the latest (at the time) `winit` version on crates.io. This bug was a blocker in getting transparency to work. Once the `winit` version was set to the master branch of the git repo, I recall that window transparency was working finally. 

Since making that comment, the fix that previously required using the master branch of `winit` should, by now, be in a crates.io release. Also, the PRs from Bevy mentioned previously and from `winit` mentioned in the original commment were both merged ages ago, and many changes have happened since then. For all those reasons, this entire conversation is no longer relevant in current Bevy versions.
